description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Ralapanawewa, Nochchiyagama D/S Division, Aunradhapura District (25/0197)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels, their locations, ownership details, and registration particulars. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements for specific parcels of land in the Anuradhapura District.
